title: curl_get_line: return error on ferror()
body:
fopen() can successfully open directories, but fgets() will always fail, while feof() will always return 0. This results in an infinite loop in curl_get_line() after 769ccb4d42 "curl_get_line: enhance the API". The fix is to force the loop to break on ferror(). Note that previous behavior was to eat the error, but since the whole point of 769ccb4d42 is to stop doing that, we instead return CURLE_READ_ERROR.

===

My apologies for not adding a test: the bug will trigger a hang, but I've been unable to figure out how to write a test in such a way that the process is killed after a timeout. I've manually verified the fix by hacking up lib1549.c to reproduce the hang then observing it go away after this change.

#20823 requests possibly actually making `CURLOPT_COOKIEFILE="/"` work. I have not yet confirmed that this will actually do that, merely that `curl_get_line()` will error out instead of hang; this PR is at least a subset of what needs to be done.
